title: SafeSWAB® Swab Drying Cabinets - Protect Evidence from Contamination
meta_title: SafeSWAB® Swab Drying Cabinets - Secure Evidence Processing
meta_description: SafeSWAB® swab drying cabinets provide effective protection for personnel and evidence from particulate hazards. Horizontal airflow and HEPA/ULPA filtration ensure a safe, controlled environment.
meta_keywords: swab drying cabinet, evidence drying, forensic lab equipment, cyanoacrylate fuming, HEPA filtration
short_description: With a HEPA main filter formulated to contain any particulates or biological material that might be present on swabs, SafeSWAB® is used to safely dry evidence swabs while protecting them from cross-contamination.
full_description: SafeSWAB® swab drying cabinets provide effective protection for personnel and evidence from particulate hazards. Featuring horizontal airflow geometry and HEPA/ULPA filtration, these cabinets create a safe, controlled environment for drying forensic evidence swabs. Key features include lockable doors for security, easy-to-change filters, and compliance with ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 standards.
seo_content: The SafeSWAB® line of swab drying cabinets is designed to meet the specialized needs of crime labs, medical examiners, law enforcement, and other agencies that handle sensitive forensic evidence. With innovative filtration technology, these cabinets safely dry swabs while preventing cross-contamination and protecting personnel from exposure to hazardous particulates.

page_content_sections.applications: SafeSWAB® swab drying cabinets are used in a variety of forensic and medical settings, including state and federal crime laboratories, medical examiner offices, law enforcement agencies, hospital emergency rooms, and drug agencies.
page_content_sections.models: The SafeSWAB® line includes two main models: the FDC-001-A with a 30 swab capacity, and the FDC-001M-A with a 15 swab capacity. Both models feature 120V, 60Hz electrical systems and HEPA/ULPA filtration.
